title: 34.1 Honest floor: the agent says it cannot see something instead of guessing
notes: Frozen 6 Oct 2026 BEFORE the feature or the bench exists. The app's own agent (core/agent.py), Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, on clips whose content is known: questions about things that are NOT in the video (the agent must abstain) and things that ARE (it must still answer correctly). Percentages of questions. Bench: tools/honest_bench.py.

metrics.why: with the honest floor on, at least 80% of questions about things not in the video get 'I cannot see that' instead of a guess
at least 75% of questions about things that ARE in the video are still answered correctly
the floor may cost at most 10 points of correct answers compared with today
advisory: if today's agent already abstains, the change matters little
